mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_batch WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} AND org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_batch SET batch_status = #{batchStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
UPDATE settlement_batch SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, execution_duration = #{executionDuration}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
UPDATE settlement_batch SET execution_result = #{executionResult}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

UPDATE settlement_batch SET transaction_count = #{transactionCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM settlement_batch WHERE batch_status IN ('CREATED', 'SCHEDULED') AND (scheduled_time IS NULL OR scheduled_time <= #{currentTime}) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 10 THEN 1 WHEN 9 THEN 2 WHEN 8 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, scheduled_time ASC, create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM settlement_batch WHERE batch_status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{thresholdMinutes} MINUTE) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT * FROM settlement_batch WHERE batch_status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as batchCount, SUM(transaction_count) as totalTransactionCount, SUM(success_count) as totalSuccessCount, SUM(failed_count) as totalFailedCount, AVG(execution_duration) as avgExecutionDuration, MAX(execution_duration) as maxExecutionDuration, MIN(execution_duration) as minExecutionDuration FROM settlement_batch WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND batch_status = 'COMPLETED' AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_batch SET retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') as hour, COUNT(*) as concurrentBatches, SUM(transaction_count) as totalTransactions, AVG(execution_duration) as avgDuration FROM settlement_batch WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND batch_status IN ('RUNNING', 'COMPLETED') AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY hour
